text:
maya: Heads-up — proposal to expose routing hints in SDK headers: X-RW-REGION, X-RW-TIER, and X-RW-FALLBACK-POLICY. Keep reading...

sam: 👍 do you mean as hints only or server-enforced?

maya: Hints by default. We add a query param / header override for enterprise dedicated customers that want strict routing.

alex: For analytics we also need to capture which hint was honored vs ignored. Telemetry event: routing.hint_received, routing.chosen_variant.

ria: UX question — Console should show per-route routing policy and be able to simulate header hints in the rollout UI.

chen: Edge case: if hint region doesn't have requested model variant, do we fall back to closest region or a lower-tier variant?

maya: Idea: fallback policy values: prefer-region, prefer-tier, any-available. Default: prefer-tier then prefer-region.

sam: Can we keep debug flag x-rw-debug=route to force a path for testing? Should be allowed in SDK dev mode only.

deploy-bot: deploy started: routing-service:v2.3 -> canary on eu-west-1 (incorporates header-hint checks)

alex: sample header snippet for SDK docs:

  curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
       -H "X-RW-REGION: eu-west-1" \
       -H "X-RW-TIER: enterprise" \
       -H "X-RW-FALLBACK-POLICY: prefer-region" \
       https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

ria: telemetry note: include route_decision_latency and fallback_count. Also surface in console per-route histogram.

chen: Security: only org-admin and SDK with org-scoped keys can set strict overrides, otherwise header is treated as hint.

sam: Good. Need a backwards-compatible plan: server ignores unknown headers; SDK v2 will add typed fields.

maya: I'll open a PR with the header parsing changes + feature flag. Also will add a console mock mode for rollout preview.

ria: Could we show 'what-if' cost delta when simulating prefer-tier? Ops want cost warning.

maya: yeah webhook in console to estimate cost.

sam: ok let's document and get a small canary. I'll file infra ticket for metrics.

maya: thanks — follow-ups: PR #432, RFC in google drive, canary next Tue. :thumbsup:
